spanish: Esta la torá: adam cuando muera en tienda, todo el entrante a la tienda y todo lo que en la tienda se impurecerá siete días.

findings.issue: הַתּוֹרָה is a common noun (H8451), left as the untranslated lemma torá.
אָדָם is a common noun (H120), not a proper name; adam leaves the lemma untranslated.
כִּי is only a conjunction; cuando selects the temporal sense and closes if/that.
Qal imperfect 3ms is smoothed to subjunctive muera; person and number stay.
Qal imperfect 3ms licenses be or become unclean. se impurecerá is inchoative smoothing, and se can be read as a reflexive the qal does not mark.

notes: Feminine Esta, indefinite en tienda, definite la tienda, the participle with אל, כל אשר, and seven days match the tokens.
